observed_inputs.observation: The active claim specifies matched NORMAL/LESION/RESCUE conditions and correctly bounds score interpretation, but it does not explicitly require a SHAM_RESCUE or UNRELATED_MODULE_RESCUE negative control.

WP800 mechanically separates evaluator-only state from ObservationView and its native matched-run primitive is pairwise BASELINE/INTERVENTION; a multi-condition lesion suite therefore needs explicit condition identity and pair-composition rules rather than assuming three-condition matching is inherited automatically.
The current research packet requires strong simpler ablations/placebos and warns that intervention/coherence alone must not mint causal credit.

finding.statement: NORMAL->LESION->RESCUE alone cannot distinguish restoration of the declared lesioned capability from generic restart/reinitialization, extra-compute, condition-label or intervention-attention effects. A successful rescue delta is therefore non-identifying unless matched sham and unrelated-module rescue controls are present.

candidate_falsifier.name: SHAM_AND_UNRELATED_RESCUE_NEGATIVE_CONTROL
matching_requirements: same fixture family and exact public fixture identity where pairwise comparison requires it
same episode generation and public ObservationView ancestry
condition identity sealed before evaluator scoring
no evaluator-only state in rescue configuration
candidate_falsifier.acceptance_logic: A target rescue is informative only when LESION_TARGET degrades the declared metric relative to NORMAL, RESCUE_TARGET reverses that lesion-associated deficit under matched budget, and neither SHAM_RESCUE_NO_TARGET_RESTORE nor RESCUE_UNRELATED_MODULE produces an equivalent recovery. Otherwise retain UNKNOWN/non-identifying result.
candidate_falsifier.pairing_note: Because WP800's native matched primitive is BASELINE/INTERVENTION, encode the multi-condition suite as sealed pairwise comparisons with one shared intervention-family identity or introduce an WP806-local immutable condition-set descriptor; do not mutate WP800 solely to support this test.

counterhypothesis: The eventual WP806 implementation may already add sham/unrelated rescue controls even though the active claim does not enumerate them. If exact-current source and tests prove those controls with sealed identities and matched budgets, this review is satisfied without widening architecture.
recommended_action_for_active_owner: Add SHAM_RESCUE and UNRELATED_MODULE_RESCUE controls plus fail-closed tests before bounded WP806 acceptance. Keep all credit at repository-hosted benchmark scope.
